steps.label: List pending Dream items and act on my natural-language instruction
steps.prompt:
MODEL POLICY: Read Dream config.json model_policy before delegating. Current cost-conscious pin: gpt-5.6-sol, reasoning_effort=xhigh, context_tier=long_context (~1M tier). EVERY sub-agent, parallel worker, reviewer and retry must explicitly pass these three launch parameters. Never inherit automatic, alternate-model, lower-effort, or default-context settings. If unavailable, report the limitation and do not fall back. Historical journals report the model actually used; do not rewrite them. This is an on-demand interactive thread for acting on Dream review items without waiting for the morning digest. Follow the operator guide EXACTLY: C:\Users\<you>\.copilot\dream\dream-action.prompt.md

First, show me what is pending:
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\<you>\.copilot\dream\dream-approve.ps1 -List
  powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\Users\<you>\.copilot\dream\dream-reject.ps1 -List
and read the newest C:\Users\<you>\.copilot\dream\journal\<today>.md "## Applied changes".

Then act on my natural-language instruction in this thread:
  - reject / discard  ->  dream-reject.ps1 -Slug <slug>
  - approve / apply    ->  apply the proposal's "## After" edit to the target skill, then dream-approve.ps1 -Slug <slug>
  - promote an active-work item to long-term  ->  fold it into the named long-term skill with a cross-reference
  - track / note       ->  dream-note.ps1 <text>
  - show changes <skill> ->  read that skill's block in the run report (last_changes.report) and summarize by section; exact diff: python ~/.copilot/dream/skillaudit.py show --run <run8> --skill <skill>
  - revert <skill>       ->  python ~/.copilot/dream/skillaudit.py revert --run <run8|last> --skill <skill> --check, then without --check if it prints OK; on CONFLICT explain and offer the options, never force it
Only act on items that actually exist; if ambiguous, ask one short question. End with a concise per-item confirmation and "Pending now: N". If I have not given an instruction yet, just show the pending list and wait.
